lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Notice and practice Swedish word order when a place or time expression comes first.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Explaining a simple daily route and where different errands happen.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Giving a clear update about where and when everyday actions happen.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk through a short route with two errands and adjust the order to save time.

main_focus.name: fronted time/place expressions with V2
main_focus.description: Start a sentence with a time or place phrase and keep the finite verb in second position.
model_examples: Klockan fem träffas vi utanför stationen.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use fronted time or place expressions naturally 4-5 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: simple connectors: sedan, efter det, men

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use route and errand words in a realistic order-planning exchange.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person describes the first errand and where it is.
dialogue_shape.middle: They reorder two errands, mention one practical constraint, and use place/time-first sentences.
dialogue_shape.ending: They settle on the route and meeting point.

target_complexity.repetition: use several clear V2 examples with fronted phrases

focus: the reason the route is changed
the final meeting point or route decision

sentence_focus: one sentence starting with på apoteket
one sentence giving a meeting point with time
